title: WhatToLookAt: learned relations become a sensing budget
summary: WhatToLookAt takes the history-written relation machinery from SighImageFactorization and asks a compressed-sensing-style engineering question: if experience has already learned useful structure, how many future physical observations can be omitted? Gates 0–4 turn learned relations into an explicit adaptive sensing budget and then into a falsifiable compression hypothesis. Gate 5 attacks the sensing operator itself: sparse measurement rows reduce fan-in/mixing work but may require more rows because sparse innovations can fall entirely outside the observed support.

nodes.claim: Learns persistent relations from past temporal structure and uses them as a prior for future sparse sensing; local relation uncertainty withdraws sharing authority and purchases extra measurements only where confidence is low.
nodes.survived: Learned relations can replace future observations in controlled worlds; charged image-derived confidence and current residuals localize when extra sensing is needed; and Gate 5 measures a nontrivial sparse-measurement frontier where moderate row sparsity preserves held-out quality while reducing guide coordinate-touch cost relative to a dense guide.
nodes.killed: Blind trust, shuffled confidence, coordinate memory and equal-cost random extra reads fail their matched controls. Gate 5 also kills the idea that arbitrarily sparse measurement rows are a free optimization: support-1 and support-2 rows do not meet the 95% end-to-end validation target even with 64 guide rows in the tested sparse-innovation world.

edges.why: WhatToLookAt explicitly states that it pushes the compressed-sensing question into the SighImageFactorization/Sihti lineage and operationalizes SighImageFactorization's learned relation state as a prior that can reduce future sensing.

WhatToLookAt explicitly names Sihti in its lineage and carries forward the operator-dependent-structure framing, but does not claim Sihti code inheritance; the new currency is measurement cost rather than residue location.
